articles.title: MASSIVE 600 ton Liebherr mining excavator converted from diesel to electric
articles.summary: Lloyds Metals and Energy has achieved a breakthrough by successfully converting one of its massive 650-ton Liebherr R 996 excavators from diesel to a fully sustainable power source. This initiative represents a significant step towards green technology in heavy machinery, aiming to reduce carbon footprint and promote eco-friendly operations in the industrial sector, demonstrating innovation in sustainable practices.

articles.title: Manipur: Two killed as armed assailants open fire on vehicles on NH-202 near Ukhrul
articles.summary: Two individuals were shot dead by unidentified armed assailants on National Highway-202 in Manipur, targeting vehicles heading towards Ukhrul. This tragic incident highlights ongoing internal security challenges and the fragile law and order situation in the region. It underscores the critical need for robust security measures and strategic interventions to ensure peace and protect citizens from such acts of violence.

articles.title: Separate case keeps ex-navy official Tiwary in Qatari jail; efforts on to free him: Sources
articles.summary: A former Indian Navy official, whose death sentence in Qatar was commuted in 2023 along with seven others, remains in custody due to a separate conviction.
